note: The closed list of `az` argument vectors the engine may start. It is a list of exact vectors, never a rule such as 'a read verb': get-access-token, keyvault secret show, config appsettings list, storage account keys list and acr credential show are get, show or list and all return secrets. {guid} is the only placeholder and is validated as a GUID. Vectors marked consent are used by `waf.mjs consent` (PR 1b); they are shipped now so the list is reviewed once.
